claims.claim: Read project-structure references selectively, only as needed for their listed topic or subtask.
claims.trigger: Loading references while scaffolding or restructuring
claims.exceptions: Specific subsequent steps may require particular references; those needs satisfy the selective-loading condition.
claims.enforcement_effect: Context-loading restriction, without a mechanical enforcement claim.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Primary labels the loading guidance implementation; replica labels it policy pointers.
Reading required stack/rules, enforcing private-reference ownership and running scaffold verification do not prohibit loading unnecessary references.

claims.comparison_reason: The negative only-as-needed loading condition is independently violable even when all required reads and ownership boundaries hold.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: For a narrow backend reference adjustment, an assistant reads all unrelated frontend and baseline-package references automatically. It can satisfy mandatory rule reads and private ownership while violating selective loading.
